name: Merino & Co. Limited
summary: Merino & Co. Limited designs, manufactures and sells wool products in Australia and internationally, including womenswear such as sweaters, cardigans, jackets, dresses and coats, menswear sweaters and cardigans, and accessories such as scarves, socks, beanies and gloves. It sells through online and physical stores. It was incorporated in 2013 and has its base in Wangara.
